attempts.rationale: I want to test a weighted combination that respects the diagnosis hint of “weighted” and uses the full pool to see if a softmax of negative errors improves over raw mean.

Try a weighted combination with the pooled_meta_model handle (w1) to see if a meta‑learner can beat the softmax baseline on this high‑trend, high‑seasonality series.

Test a weighted combination on a reduced pool to see if focusing on the best performers (rf, DWT_rf, FT_rf, DWT_catboost, ONLY_DWT_rf) improves over full pool weighted.
Test a weighted combination over pool1 using softmax_neg_error to see if a lighter weighting scheme improves over inverse_error.
I want to explore a weighted combination on pool2, which adds THETA and expands the set; using softmax_neg_error may better capture relative performance.
The series has strong trend and seasonality; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models in the full pool.
Test a median combination on the focused pool1 to see if a simple robust statistic beats weighted on the same pool.
Test a weighted combination over the full pool using inverse_error weights to see if a full‑pool weighted blend can beat the focused pool best.
Try a weighted combination on pool3 with inverse_error weights to see if adding ARIMA/THETA helps complement pool1’s strong models.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but moderate ranking stability; a simple mean over the focused pool1 might outperform weighted due to low variance in weights.
